Testing Categories

Drilling fluid testing — from field to lab

Blick carries Fann testing equipment across three tiers — daily field tests every crew should run, diagnostic instruments for troubleshooting, and lab-grade rheology for Mud School and complex projects.

Field Test Kits

The daily essentials every drilling crew needs on site. Includes pH & water hardness strips for monitoring make-up water, Marsh Funnel & Cup for viscosity checks, and Mud Balance for fluid density. Quick, reliable tests that catch problems before they cost you time.

View on fann.com

Filtration & Solids Analysis

Diagnostic instruments for when you need to understand what's happening downhole. Sand Content Kits measure solids percentage (API 200-mesh), while the Half-Area Filter Press tests fluid-loss control under 100 PSI — the key test for bentonite system performance.

View on fann.com

Rheology & Viscometry

Lab-grade instruments for detailed fluid characterisation. The Fann Model 35 Viscometer measures plastic viscosity, yield point, and gel strength at multiple shear rates — essential for optimising fluid programs on complex bores and the centrepiece of every Blick Mud School.

View on fann.com

Fluids you'll be testing

Fann instruments are designed to test and optimise drilling fluid systems. Here are the Blick fluids your equipment will help you monitor and control.

Core Fluid

HDD Gel

The fluid you'll be testing most. Premium bentonite for hole stability and fluid-loss control.

 Stabiliser

Carry Flow

Test viscosity and carrying capacity with your Marsh Funnel — Carry Flow is designed to hit the numbers.

 Additive

Clay Control

When your pH strips show reactive clay — Clay Control inhibits swelling and keeps the bore stable.

 Additive

Detergent

Clean your testing equipment between samples — Detergent removes drilling fluid residue quickly.
